note: SHRINK-ONLY. Credential SHAPES in tracked files. Entries here are legitimate, permanent test fixtures -- a validly-shaped key or token that a test cannot do without. Nothing separates a good fixture from a real credential by shape, so the known ones are frozen and anything new reds. AWS_KEY_ID entries are NOT expected here at all: there are no AWS-id fixtures in this repo, so one appearing means a real access key id was committed to a PUBLIC remote -- rotate it, do not baseline it. A TOKEN entry is only ever a fixture whose value is visibly synthetic (the one here is the literal alphabet); a real-looking token belongs in a revocation, not in this file.
